hot_followup_72h.scope: Current lead statuses; displayed lead owners; VP/blank business line; all booking dates

metric_definitions.closed_won: MTD opportunity/date_won grain; historical wins retained

scorecard_meta.anchor: Actions count from meeting starts_at; deadline is 12 elapsed hours after ends_at (scheduled end)
scorecard_meta.cash_basis: Cash Collected on the shared MTD included won opportunities, grouped by date_won and displayed owner
scorecard_meta.close_basis: Shared MTD won opportunities divided by its occurred first calls, including historical closer credit
scorecard_meta.cohort_basis: Existing post-call exemptions; full active-roster process cohort; any-sender pre-call Loom links; VP/blank business-line process scope
scorecard_meta.next_step_basis: Existing task-or-follow-up-meeting eligibility, plus creation within the same 12-hour response window
scorecard_meta.recap_basis: Any sent outbound email on the lead; no content/template/sender restriction; SMS excluded

warm_followup_5d.scope: Current lead statuses; displayed lead owners; VP/blank business line; all booking dates
